dct_description_sm: The Heritage Resource Inventory is an unofficial list of properties deemed to have heritage value. It was created in the 1980s and was the City’s first large scale attempt to identify heritage resources within the City. Properties listed on this map are not all subject to formal, legal protection.
dct_rights_sm: The City of New Westminster publishes open data under the terms of the Open Government Licence - City of New Westminster. You are encouraged to use the Information that is available under this licence with only a few conditions.
